title: Fix admin dashboard permissions for saving edits and images

requirements.text: Modify the backend authorization logic to allow authenticated admin users to save edits and replace Nakshatra images without the 'only administrators can replace Nakshatra images' error

quotes: error: only adminstrators can replace Nakshatra images

acceptanceCriteria: Admin users authenticated via passcode can successfully save Nakshatra edits
Admin users can replace Nakshatra images without authorization errors
The 'only administrators can replace Nakshatra images' error no longer occurs for authenticated admins

requirements.text: Ensure the admin authentication state from usePasscodeAuth properly authorizes backend write operations for both Nakshatra data updates and image replacements

quotes: please allow me to make exits and save new images in the admin dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: Passcode authentication grants full write permissions for Nakshatra operations
Image upload and replacement operations succeed when admin is authenticated
Authorization errors are prevented for all admin write operations

requirements.text: Verify that the AdminEditPage form successfully submits both Nakshatra data edits and image updates without permission errors

quotes: It is currently not allowing me to save the edits and updated images

acceptanceCriteria: Save button on AdminEditPage successfully commits all changes
Image uploads complete without authorization errors
Success toast confirmation appears after successful saves
Updated data and images are immediately reflected in the admin dashboard

constraints: Maintain the existing passcode-based authentication system
Do not break the current admin authentication flow
Preserve all existing Nakshatra data and images
nonGoals: Changing the authentication mechanism from passcode to Internet Identity
Adding role-based access control beyond admin/non-admin
Modifying the frontend UI layout or styling
